notes:
- Inbound from a mid-sized support automation vendor building a lightweight AI layer on top of Zendesk.
- Primary ask: Hosted API (self-serve) for rapid proof-of-value; likely to onboard via sandbox keys and upgrade if latency/cost OK.
- Workload: high-volume ticket summarization + auto-fill (subject, category, triage tags) and agent-assist chat snippets. Emphasis on structured JSON output to push back into Zendesk fields via webhooks.
- Tool calling: want ability to call internal triage microservice (ticket-enrich) to attach metadata (customer_tier, recent_purchases). Demoed Redwood tool-calling flow; customer liked the idea of deterministic function outputs.
- Latency / throughput targets: p95 <= 200ms for short summaries (<=200 tokens), bursty spikes up to ~60 requests/sec during morning ticket surge.
- Cost sensitivity: high — SMB budget. Asking for guidance on batching, KV caching, and token-level cost optimizations.
- Model preference: prefer smaller open models or Redwood-curated lightweight variants; want fallbacks for cheaper routing during non-business hours.
- Security: must support SSO (SAML) for console, audit logs for API usage, and 30-day retention controls for transcripts. No current need for on-prem or VPC; public cloud acceptable.
- Quote from CTO on call: "We need consistent JSON outputs we can rely on to auto-populate Zendesk macros — if parsing fails we create more work than value."
- Integration notes: will likely wire into existing Zendesk workflows; asked about webhook latency and retry semantics. SE to document webhook examples.
- Internal spike: ran 500-ticket batch through Redwood-hosted trial prompts; initial summaries looked good but inconsistent category tags (SE suggested using structured-output templates and shot examples).
- Risks: cost for high-frequency summarization, mapping taxonomies to their existing tags, SAML setup timing.
- Next: 30m POC walkthrough week of 2026-03-15, provide sandbox API key + sample prompt pack + simple cost calc for 50k tickets/month.
- Short-term win: demonstrate structured-output JSON for subject, priority, category, suggested macro ID.
